```{r}
# Remove essential genes
setwd("~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/results/mageck/Mageck_VISPR_RRA_CNV/results/test/")
input <- read.table("rra_pDNA_Input.gene_summary.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
essential_genes <- input[input$neg.fdr < 0.05, ]$id
cd8_ctla44 <- read.table("rra_CD8_CTLA4.4.gene_summary.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
cd8_nt <- read.table("rra_CD8_NT.gene_summary.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
remove_essential <- function(gene_summary, genes, filename){
  result <- read.table(gene_summary, sep="\t", header=T)
  new_result <- result[!(result$id %in% genes),]
  write.table(new_result, filename, sep="\t",row.names=F)
}
remove_essential("rra_CD8_NT.gene_summary.txt", essential_genes, "rra_CD8_NT_noneessential.gene_summary.txt")
```

```{r}
plot_invivo <- function(dat){
  dat <- transform(dat, pvalue = pmin(pos.p.value, neg.p.value))
  EnhancedVolcano(dat,lab=dat$id,x="pos.lfc", y="pvalue",pCutoff=0.01,labSize=4,title="CTLA4 vs. NT",pointSize=1,drawConnectors = T)
}
plot_invivo(NT_ctla44)
```

```{r}
# Make gene rank plot. Input: original CRISPR result gene summary. Output: slightly modified dataframe with 
edit_crispr <- function(crispr, title){
  colnames(crispr) <- gsub("\\|",".",colnames(crispr))
  crispr <- crispr[!is.na(crispr$id),] # Remove row with NA
  crispr <- crispr[!duplicated(crispr$id),]
  rownames(crispr) <- NULL
  crispr <- column_to_rownames(crispr, 'id')
  
  # Combine positive and negative scores, log normalize
  crispr$score <- 'NA'
  crispr$score[crispr$neg.lfc<0] <- log10(crispr[crispr$neg.lfc<0, 'neg.score'])
  crispr$score[crispr$neg.lfc>0] <- (-log10(crispr[crispr$neg.lfc>0, 'pos.score']))
  crispr$score <- as.numeric(crispr$score)
  crispr <- crispr[order(crispr$score),] # Order the genes by score
  crispr$rank <- seq(1,dim(crispr)[1]) # Assign gene rank based on scores
  
  # Make new column for labeling genes. Label top 10 genes
  crispr <- crispr %>% mutate(genelabels = "") # genelabels: column of gene names for genes to label
  crispr$genelabels[1:10] <- rownames(crispr)[1:10]
  crispr$genelabels[(nrow(crispr)-9): nrow(crispr)] <- rownames(crispr)[(nrow(crispr)-9): nrow(crispr)]
  #crispr <- crispr %>% mutate(thres = neg.fdr <0.05 | pos.fdr <0.05)
  crispr$thres <- 'no' # Thres: defines genes as neg, pos, neg.ctl or pos.ctl. Cutoff: p-value<0.05
  crispr[crispr$neg.fdr<0.05 & crispr$neg.lfc<0,'thres'] <- 'neg'
  crispr[crispr$pos.fdr<0.05 & crispr$neg.lfc>0,'thres'] <- 'pos'
  
  # Plot norm_z-score vs. gene rank
  print(ggplot(crispr,aes(x=rank, y=score,color = thres)) + geom_point() +
    geom_point(data=crispr[crispr$thres %in% c('neg.ctl','pos.ctl'),])+
    #geom_text_repel(aes(label=genelabels), max.overlaps=Inf, segment.color = NA,size=4) +
    scale_color_manual(limits = c('no', 'pos', 'neg'), 
                       values=c('darkgrey', 'orange','skyblue'), name = NULL,
                       labels=c('Not significant', 'Sensitizer Genes','Resistance Genes'))+
    theme_classic() + xlab('Rank') + ylab('normZ Score') + geom_hline(yintercept=0)+ggtitle(title)+
    theme(axis.text=element_text(size=13), axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"),
          axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5,hjust=0.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size=12),legend.position = "none",plot.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold", hjust=0.5)))
  return(crispr)
}
cd8_ctla4_new <- edit_crispr(cd8_ctla4, "CTLA4 vs. CD8-Depleted")
nt_ctla4_new <- edit_crispr(nt_ctla4, "CTLA4 vs. NT")
nt_cd8_new <- edit_crispr(cd8_nt, "NT vs. aCD8")
```
